item.text: The new separation is working. I’m removing the temporary `out/` tree and then I’ll summarize the design change.

Decoupled the shared match-view API from the compiled algorithm object. [KmpMatchView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/KmpMatchView.java:12) now exposes `patternText()` instead of `pattern()`, which means a read-only match snapshot no longer needs to retain or expose the full compiled `KmpPattern`.

That let [KmpMatchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/KmpMatchResult.java:8) become a cleaner immutable snapshot containing only the pattern text, source text, and match indices. [KmpMatcher.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/KmpMatcher.java:10) still exposes the compiled pattern for execution concerns, but its shared-view behavior now stays at the textual/result level. I updated the demo and tests accordingly, especially the common `KmpMatchView` assertions in [KmpSearchSelfTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/test/java/com/example/kmp/KmpSearchSelfTest.java:98).
